'''André Roberson''' (born December 4, 1991) is an American [[basketball]] player.  He played [[college basketball]] for the [[University of Colorado Boulder]] (CU) and is a candidate for the [[2013 NBA Draft]].

Roberson, a 6'7" [[Forward (basketball)|forward]] from [[San Antonio, Texas]], played for the [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado Buffaloes]] under coach [[Tad Boyle]].  In his three seasons at CU, Roberson was one of the country's top rebounders—finishing third in the country in both the [[2011–12 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2011–12]] and [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2012–13]] seasons.  He led the Buffs to the NCAA Tournament both years.<ref name=BIO>{{cite web| last = | first = | title =André Roberson Colorado bio | publisher = Colorado Buffaloes | date = | url =http://www.cubuffs.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=600&ATCLID=204970260 | accessdate = May 4, 2013}}</ref>

As a junior in 2012–13, Roberson averaged 10.9 [[Points per game|points]] and 11.2 [[rebounds per game]].  He was named first team [[List of All-Pacific-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]] and the conference Defensive player of the Year.<ref>{{cite web| last = | first = | title =CU Buffs' Andre Roberson named Pac-12 defensive player of the year | publisher = [[Denver Post]] | date =March 11, 2013 | url =http://www.denverpost.com/cu/ci_22768520/cu-buffs-andre-roberson-named-pac-12-defensive | accessdate = May 4, 2013}}</ref>

At the close of his junior season, Roberson declared his eligibility for the 2013 NBA Draft.<ref>{{cite web| last = | first = | title =Andre Roberson entering NBA draft | publisher = ESPN.com | date =April 28, 2013 | url =http://espn.go.com/nba/draft2013/story/_/id/9221890/colorado-buffaloes-junior-andre-roberson-entering-nba-draft | accessdate = May 4, 2013}}</ref>
